items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1959-06-02
items.q: Not as I know of. No, I don't know. I don't think Frankie Doosen would play with Bolden. Maybe he was. He could have played with him, but I don't remember him. But he was a good old trombone player too.

ctx.x: Did Frankie Doosen ever play with Bolden? Do you remember?

Not as I know of. No, I don't know. I don't think Frankie Doosen would play with Bolden. Maybe he was. He could have played with him, but I don't remember him. But he was a good old trombone player too. He had plenty headway with him. Not much of a year. Plenty headway.
Can you tell me about, some more about Baptiste de Lille? I never got to know him. He died long before my time. I wonder. No, I don't think so.
